dinners.name: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork + Sweet Potato + Broccoli
dinners.note: Start the shoulder in the morning. Makes enough for Sunday dinner + Tuesday + Thursday. Jake gets more pork, Laine more sweet potato.

ingredients.item: Garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, salt

steps: For the pork shoulder batch: rub the whole shoulder with cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, chili flakes. Add 1/2 cup water to slow cooker. Cook on LOW 8 hrs or HIGH 4-5 hrs. Shred and portion into 3 dinner-sized containers plus lunch use.
Toss sweet potato with oil, smoked paprika, salt. Roast at 410F / 210C for 25 min.
Toss broccoli with remaining oil + salt. Add to pan for last 15 min.
Plate: Jake gets more pork + less potato. Laine gets less pork + more potato.

dinners.name: Pulled Pork Pasta (Leftover Pork + Tomato Sauce)
dinners.note: Use the roasted onion & garlic pasta sauce jar. Jake gets more pasta, Laine more sauce/veg ratio. Use gemelli or casarecce.

ingredients.item: Signature Select roasted onion & garlic pasta sauce

steps: Cook pasta per package in salted water. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water before draining.
Warm pulled pork in a pan over medium heat. Add pasta sauce, stir together.
Add drained pasta to the pan, toss with sauce + pork. Add pasta water if needed to loosen.
Stir in baby spinach off heat until just wilted.
Plate with Jake's larger pasta portion. Garnish with bread crumbs.

dinners.name: Shrimp + Garbanzo Bean + Spinach Skillet
dinners.note: Quick weeknight. Jake gets more shrimp, Laine gets more beans. Use the garbanzo can and frozen shrimp.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add garbanzo beans and diced tomatoes. Simmer 5 min.
Add all shrimp. Cook 2 min per side until pink.
Stir in spinach off heat. Finish with lemon juice.
Plate: Jake gets more shrimp, Laine gets more beans.

dinners.name: Pulled Pork Chili (Leftover Pork + Dennison's Base)
dinners.note: Use one can Dennison's chili as the flavor base + add the leftover pork. Hearty and zero effort. Jake eats more.

ingredients.item: Dennison's chunky chili with beans (1 can)
Black beans (Sun Vista or Bush's), drained

steps: Combine canned chili, black beans, green chiles, and pulled pork in a pot.
Simmer on medium 15 min, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust salt/cumin/chili powder.
Ladle into bowls: Jake gets a larger portion. Top with sour cream.

dinners.name: Baked Cod + Lentil Soup (Leftover) + Frozen Veg
dinners.note: Light Friday. Laine gets more lentil soup base, Jake more cod. Use frozen cod and any leftover lentils or make a quick new batch.

ingredients.item: Lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, cumin, paprika

steps: Simmer lentils with diced tomatoes, cumin, garlic, and 2 cups water for 20 min. Season with salt + lemon.
Season cod with paprika, salt, lemon zest. Bake at 400F / 200C for 12-14 min.
Steam frozen veggies per package.
Laine gets larger lentil bowl + smaller cod. Jake gets larger cod + smaller soup.

dinners.name: Turkey & Pinto Bean Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
dinners.note: Ground turkey from freezer + pinto beans. Laine gets a bigger potato, Jake gets more turkey. Fun and filling.

ingredients.item: Hatch green chiles or diced tomatoes
Daisy sour cream + cumin + garlic powder

steps: Pierce sweet potatoes, bake at 400F / 200C for 45-50 min until soft.
Brown ground turkey in a skillet with cumin, garlic powder, salt. Drain excess fat.
Add pinto beans + green chiles/tomatoes. Simmer 5 min.
Split sweet potatoes open. Spoon turkey-bean mixture on top.
Jake gets more turkey filling. Laine gets bigger potato. Top with sour cream.

dinners.name: Mandarin Orange Chicken + Lentils + Frozen Veggies
dinners.note: Trader Joe's night — easy. Jake gets extra lentils for protein. Laine gets more veg. Use frozen veggie bag of choice.

ingredients.item: Frozen veggies (edamame, stir-fry blend, or broccoli)

steps: Simmer lentils in salted water — Jake's portion 20 min, they're done when tender. Drain.
Bake orange chicken per package (usually 400F for 20-22 min, toss halfway).
Microwave or steam frozen veggies per package.
Plate: Jake gets larger chicken + lentil portion. Laine gets smaller chicken + more veg.

jakeLunch.name: Chicken + White Bean + Spinach Pasta Batch
jakeLunch.note: Make the full batch Sunday, divide into 5 equal containers. High protein for Jake. Uses pasta, white beans, chicken breast, spinach, and pesto.

ingredients.item: Garofalo gemelli or spaghetti, 12 oz dry
Prego creamy parmesan pesto - 3 tbsp total

steps: Season ALL chicken breast with salt, garlic powder, pepper. Bake at 400F for 24 min. Cool and slice or shred the whole batch.
Cook ALL pasta per package in salted water. Drain, toss immediately with pesto to prevent sticking.
Drain and rinse cannellini beans.
Divide evenly: pasta base across 5 containers, then beans, then chicken on top, then spinach (it will wilt when reheated), then a squeeze of lemon.
Reheat 2 min — add a small splash of water before microwaving so pasta doesn't dry out.

laineLunch.name: Shrimp + Lentil + Veggie Bowl
laineLunch.note: Laine's batch — no chicken. Uses frozen shrimp, lentils, frozen veggies, and diced tomatoes. Higher carb, lower fat for her macros. Divide into 5 containers.

ingredients.item: Great Value diced tomatoes - 1 large can
Frozen veggies (stir-fry blend or edamame) - 3 cups
Lemon juice, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, salt

steps: Cook ALL lentils: simmer in salted water with cumin + garlic for 20 min. Drain and dress with olive oil + lemon.
Cook ALL shrimp: toss with smoked paprika + salt. Pan sear in batches 2 min per side. Set aside.
Steam or microwave ALL frozen veggies per package.
Heat diced tomatoes in the same pan 3 min to reduce slightly.
Divide evenly across 5 containers: lentils base, tomato-veggie mix, shrimp on top. Squeeze lemon over each. Refrigerate.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with thawed frozen fruit, granola, and flaxseed.
Tip: prep night before in a jar — add granola in the morning.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble + Cottage Cheese

ingredients.item: Diced tomatoes or frozen veg - 1/4 cup

steps: Scramble egg whites over medium-low with spinach and veg until just set.
Serve alongside cottage cheese — season both with salt, pepper, chili flakes.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Protein Pancakes + Fruit
steps: Mix pancake mix with egg whites and water per package directions.
Cook small pancakes on a non-stick pan over medium heat, 2 min per side.
Top with thawed frozen fruit or sliced apple. Add flaxseed on the side.

jakeSnacks.name: Cottage Cheese + Walnuts
jakeSnacks.desc: 3/4 cup 1% cottage cheese + small handful of walnuts. No prep.

jakeSnacks.name: Protein Shake
jakeSnacks.desc: 1-2 scoops protein powder with water or a splash of milk. Use if hitting protein is a struggle.

jakeSnacks.name: Clif Bar
jakeSnacks.desc: On-hand, no prep. Good pre-workout or afternoon bridge.

jakeSnacks.name: Hard-Boiled Egg Whites + Cottage Cheese
jakeSnacks.desc: Use the liquid egg whites — microwave in a mug 90 sec. Add cottage cheese alongside.
